professionalSummary.text: Project manager on a bank's wealth platform onboarding programme for three years, running onboarding projects for two regions under the bank's delivery framework with migration plans and adviser training schedules.
professionalSummary.witness: Project manager on a bank's wealth platform onboarding programme for three years, running the onboarding projects for two regions under the bank's delivery framework with their migration plans and adviser training schedules.

professionalSummary.text: Steered senior advisers through migration under the programme's adviser engagement plan, with engagement log recording 58 objections raised, resolution of each, and two regions' migration completed with all advisers onboarded on schedule.
professionalSummary.witness: Steered the two regions' senior advisers through the migration under the programme's adviser engagement plan; the engagement log records the fifty-eight adviser objections raised, the resolution of each, and the two regions' migration completed with every adviser onboarded on schedule.

professionalSummary.text: Prepared weekly steering report for head of wealth change and managed dependencies with platform vendor and adviser operations through framework's dependency log.
professionalSummary.witness: Prepared the weekly steering report for the head of wealth change and managed the dependencies with the platform vendor and adviser operations through the framework's dependency log.

professionalSummary.text: Prepared migration readiness review for each migration wave, with go-ahead recorded as regional wealth director's and responsibility boundaries documented.
professionalSummary.witness: Prepared the migration readiness review for each migration wave; the go-ahead was the regional wealth director's, recorded on the review together with which checks were mine and which were adviser operations'.

professionalSummary.text: Wrote closure report for each region with project boundary statement and client migration evidence accepted by programme office.
professionalSummary.witness: Wrote the closure report for each region with the project boundary statement and the client migration evidence accepted by the programme office.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Work sample includes one migration plan with training schedule, adviser engagement log extract, readiness review with director's go-ahead, and closure report, with programme office references as verification trail.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: one migration plan with its training schedule, the adviser engagement log extract for one region, one readiness review with the director's go-ahead and one closure report, with the programme office references as a verification trail.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish the candidate's role as a project manager on the wealth platform onboarding programme for two regions over three years, including specific responsibilities and documentation as described in the job requirements. The materials do not establish the candidate's ability to steer senior advisers through resistance, as this is only mentioned in a note from an interviewer that is not tied to observable evidence.

evidence.text: Project manager on a bank's wealth platform onboarding programme for three years, running the onboarding projects for two regions under the bank's delivery framework with their migration plans and adviser training schedules.

Steered the two regions' senior advisers through the migration under the programme's adviser engagement plan; the engagement log records the fifty-eight adviser objections raised, the resolution of each, and the two regions' migration completed with every adviser onboarded on schedule.
Prepared the weekly steering report for the head of wealth change and managed the dependencies with the platform vendor and adviser operations through the framework's dependency log.

Prepared the migration readiness review for each migration wave; the go-ahead was the regional wealth director's, recorded on the review together with which checks were mine and which were adviser operations'.
Wrote the closure report for each region with the project boundary statement and the client migration evidence accepted by the programme office.
